Vault Service#

Endpoints#

GET /vault/v202312alpha1/secrets#

List secrets.

Returns list of secret values stored in Kentik vault.

Parameters#

Name

In

Type

Required

names

query

string[]

Yes

Responses#

Status

Description

Model

200

A successful response.

ListSecretResponse

default

An unexpected error response.

rpcStatus

Example#

from kentik_api.client import KentikAPI

client = KentikAPI()  # loads KENTIK_EMAIL/KENTIK_API_TOKEN from .env
response = client.vault.list_secret(
    names=["names-example"],
)

GET /vault/v202312alpha1/secrets/{name}#

Get a secret by name.

Returns a secret value stored in Kentik vault.

Parameters#

Name

In

Type

Required

name

path

string

Yes

Responses#

Status

Description

Model

200

A successful response.

GetSecretResponse

default

An unexpected error response.

rpcStatus

Example#

from kentik_api.client import KentikAPI

client = KentikAPI()  # loads KENTIK_EMAIL/KENTIK_API_TOKEN from .env
response = client.vault.get_secret(
    name="name-example",
)
